name: Lo no Yu
source:
Because their apartment had no bathtub, Amami's father took her to the men's hot spa.

"I'll wash your back, Amami-chan." Such a loving family. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE122375.html]DLsite English[/url]]
